vBRIEFInfo.description: CLI scaffolding, init command, and config system

plan.title: CLI Scaffold and Config
plan.narrative: Set up the project structure (pyproject.toml, Typer CLI entrypoint, pydantic-settings config model) and implement the 'init' and 'config' commands. The init command creates a project folder with config.yaml and .ghostreader/ state directory. The config command views and edits settings (default model, genre, depth). Traces: FR-1, FR-5, FR-17, FR-21.

items.title: Project skeleton
items.narrative: pyproject.toml with dependencies, ghostreader/ package, cli.py with Typer app, __init__.py. Matches the project structure from the specification.

items.title: Config model
items.narrative: pydantic-settings model for config.yaml: default_model, genre, depth, model_preference_order, api_keys references. FR-5, FR-17.

items.title: Init command
items.narrative: 'ghostreader init <project_name>' creates project folder, config.yaml from defaults, .ghostreader/ state directory. FR-1.

items.title: Config command
items.narrative: 'ghostreader config' views current config; 'ghostreader config set <key> <value>' edits. FR-5.
